decisions.reason: Restricting red color usage for the Elon Musk article does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The article color restriction does not alter the required digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The visual-style change does not alter the digital magazine launch target or deadline.
The restriction on red within the Elon Musk article does not change author-name or author-photo attribution requirements.
The article and cover color rule does not change flipbook hosting cost or candidate platform requirements.
